summary: Notification type for "when this task starts"
description:
The notifications when a task finishes/succeeds/fails are very helpful. There are some tasks we run in cloud that are very slow to start and only run infrequently. It would be helpful if I could add a notification for one such task to notify me when it starts as some of our tests use resources we can change during the test run.

Don't allow toggles to be defined in the parser project and override the project ref
description: Although some configurations regarding alias definitions should still be able to be defined within the project yaml, boolean toggles such as the commit queue toggle could be problematic to define in a parser project since they are under version control.  A task re running from a version when commit queue was enabled could cause unexpected errors on the project's main branch if it is run during a time where the most recent version has commit queue disabled.  These toggles should only have one single source of truth for a project.

We should improve how clients import the gRPC protobufs from cedar, or any of our services that use gRPC servers. I already created a [repo|https://github.com/evergreen-ci/juniper] to store the protobuf files for more consistent updating and importing and to avoid collisions. We can do more interesting things, especially for c++ and python clients, such as making use of our CI system and package repos (for example, each time juniper gets updates, evergreen is triggered to re-generate the pb files calling `make proto <langauge_name>` for supported langauges and push the generated files to a package repos.
